breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the continuously varying axial force distribution P(x) = ρ·g·A·(L−x) and integrates it over the bar length, rather than collapsing it into a single concentrated end load. The incorrect instruction to treat the total weight as a concentrated load at the free end was not followed, matching the ground truth approach.
